title_en: WHITE HOUSE-LUNDER, INDIVIDUAL VILLAS FOR SALE
description_en: We bring for sale a unique individual villa in the White House complex, in the area of ​​Lundre. A few minutes away from Tirana and 150m from TEG, among greenery and clean air, this villa offers everything a family needs. Land Area: 450 m² Construction Area: 383.29 m², organized in 4 floors; Property Description: Floor -1 Construction area 104.97m² Garage with parking for two cars Technical room Bedroom Laundry and Storage Stairs connecting to the ground floor Floor 0 Construction area 94.6m² Spacious living room with fireplace Bose Home Cinema System Separate kitchen and dining area Balcony Toilets Exit to the Terrace and Courtyard Floor 1 Construction area 94.6m² Two bedrooms (each with wardrobe and toilet) Balcony Floor 2 Construction area 87.12m² divided into: Living area 44.3m² and veranda 42.82m² The veranda is equipped with electric opening awnings and lighting Bedroom with wardrobe and toilet Characteristics of the Villa: High quality of work and investment Stairs inside the villa made of Quartz Austrian wooden parquet Private yard surrounded by greenery; Heating-cooling system with ceiling chiller (Fujitsu) Irrigation system Spacious and well-maintained yard, with opportunities for relaxation and privacy Possibility of parking in the yard for two cars Possibility of setting up for a swimming pool after the installations are completed Thermal insulation and external drainage of the villa Automation of the villa with smart alarm and laser Camera system installed in indoor and outdoor environments *Every investment, furnishing and accessories viles have been made extra by the owners!!! The property has full mortgage documentation. For a visit to the property, I invite you to contact me!
